title: Outrageously Garlicky Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring chicken, garlic, and colatura, all wrapped in a low-glycemic friendly empanada dough, these empanadas are perfect for a snack or lunch. They are garlicky, molten, and energizing.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chicken, garlic, colatura, salt, and black pepper.
Knead the empanada dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place 1/4 cup of the chicken mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the egg wash and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the olive oil and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the empanadas for 25 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy.
